title: Output panel: capture Ruffle trace() output during Test Movie
description: In Flash 8, trace() calls in AS2 appear in the Output panel. Currently, Ruffle's trace() output only goes to the browser console (with logLevel: 'info'). Add an Output panel that: (1) captures Ruffle console output (trace messages) during Test Movie playback by intercepting Ruffle's log callbacks; (2) shows the output in a scrollable panel below the editor; (3) clears on each new Test Movie run. The CLAUDE.md note confirms Ruffle emits trace() at info log level — wire up a console interceptor or Ruffle's onTrace callback.
